data.name: 萍城异闻录(PingCity)
data.detailed_description:
PingCity, officially tested on PC

PingCity, officially tested on PC, join the player group and give us feedback

At present, the official player group has been opened, and first-hand information will be updated synchronously in the group. Internal testing and other welfare activities will be held, and there is also a chance to participate in the competition and win physical rewards such as JD cards. Welcome to join the discussion together, young heroes!

QQ1：1015905671     QQ2：342072404      Discord：Dn8rZRfQkP


About the Game

Pingcheng Chronicles: Tales of the Unusual

Anime-style graphics meet fast-paced, high-octane combat—redefining the ARPG competitive experience! Unleash smooth combo chains at your fingertips, with seamless links between normal attacks and skills. Harness fire, water, thunder, and other elemental fusion mechanics to dish out devastating full-screen damage—maximizing that unbeatable combat thrill!

Innovative Gameplay: Ditch Traditional Tropes

  • Break the "Search-Fight-Evacuate" Loop: Upload on-field supplies to lock ownership instantly. No evacuation needed—keep hunting other players and plundering massive resources for doubled competitive excitement!

  • Per-Match Support Synergies: Collect gold to unlock support lineups. Trigger exclusive bonds between characters to stack powerful buffs—your strategic combinations determine the battle’s outcome!

  • Freeform Soul Card System: Gather three types of soul cards (Damage, Support, Utility) in-game. With hundreds of combinations, craft your unique combat build for a fresh experience every match!

Free Economy: Stress-Free Farming & Monetization

  • Built-in open marketplace: Freely price and trade dungeon drops, plundered loot, and more—easily monetize your grind!

  • No binding restrictions: Rare items go live and circulate instantly. Even casual players can achieve resource freedom through strategy and grit!

Game Features

  • 【Support for War】

In the game, you can recruit auxiliary characters at any time to form a match with your main battle character and trigger super powerful combination skills.

  • 【 Bonds 】

Heroes have a binding effect on each other, forming a suitable lineup and triggering the binding effect, making battles more profound and nurturing.

  • 【Soul Cards】

Master soul cards to trigger fusion damage—they are the key to victory whether you fight, defend, advance or retreat!

Controls: Right-click to bring up the wheel menu, left-click to activate.

Experience the thrilling rush of intense combat!

  • 【Search · Battle · Upload】

Search chests, jars and other containers to seize high-value supplies!

Stay vigilant against the covetous enemies lurking nearby while plundering—always be ready for battle!

Take all your supplies to the designated upload point, hold your ground until the upload is complete, and your loot will be instantly stored in your warehouse!

  • 【Hide and Seek】

The hide and seek system has been added, allowing you to take on various forms within the scene to evade the pursuit of other players, plot against them, or provide a safe environment for yourself to search for battle heroes.

  • 【Elemental Reaction】

The game has 8 types of elemental damage, and all 7 elements except physics can react with each other. Different elemental reactions have different negative effects on the target, which also affects your lineup selection.

  • 【The Great Demon King】

In the game, you can defeat the dragon beasts in the scene to obtain a dragon soul. The dragon soul will transform you into a great demon king, increasing your damage but also causing you to suffer higher damage. At this point, you will become the most prominent one on the field.

  • 【Evasion, blocking, floating pursuit, lightness skill】

Combat involves diverse ways of behavior, use them flexibly, and become a master of combat.

  • 【Rich PVE content】

A large amount of PVE content has been completed and will be presented to everyone in the future.

data.short_description: This is a different chicken eating game, where you can choose a main battle character to fight, defeat other players and monsters in the scene to earn currency, form your team lineup, and have rich combos to bring a different experience.
data.supported_languages:
Simplified Chinese*, English, Japanese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3225, AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, ATI Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64Bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K , AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 , AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 MB available space
